title: RecordDetailView: deleting a record asks through the native window.confirm, while the list view already uses the in-app confirm dialog
body:
## Symptom

On a record page, **更多操作 → 删除** opens the browser's native `window.confirm` box (「确定要删除此记录吗?」). Everywhere else the console confirms destructive actions with its own styled dialog, and so does deleting the same record from the list view.

## Mechanism

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` (objectui main `4b742f41d`, around line 2399): `if (!window.confirm(msg)) return;` in the `delete` header action's `onClick`.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` (around line 2216) says it uses the confirm dialog and a Sonner toast "instead of native window.confirm".
- `useObjectActions` also documents a confirm-handler seam that falls back to `window.confirm`.

The native box cannot be themed or localized beyond the passed string. Headless automation dismisses it by default, which also makes the delete look like a dead button to any test that does not register a dialog handler.

## Reproduction

1. objectstack showcase at objectui pin `dd3f7e1be356`, as the owner.
2. Open any `showcase_project` record.
3. Choose 更多操作 → 删除. A native browser confirm appears.

## Expected

The record-page delete goes through the same in-app confirm dialog the list view uses.
